scenarios.name: restricted-red-mana-unavailable-without-swamp-or-mountain
scenarios.why: With no land having either named subtype, the restricted red ability cannot be selected; the unrestricted black ability remains available.

scenarios.name: restricted-red-mana-available-with-mountain
scenarios.why: A Mountain meets the restriction, so choosing the red-producing ability taps the Verge and adds red mana.
